observation: P229 successfully restored six historical Evidence; owner screenshot shows temporary staging file deleted with source and target matching canonical SHA-256 prior to deletion; P217/P218 two Evidence and two Unknown revisions remain unavailable.

original_source_findings.evidence: BinarySession.close() calls #closeActive(options); #closeActive has clearRecords=true by default and executes if (clearRecords) this.clearSessionRecords().
clearSessionRecords() calls this.#records.clear(); clears session snapshot and invalidation status.
close_binary without snapshot_path explicitly calls session.close({progress}); with snapshot_path calls session.closeWithSnapshot(path, overwrite).
After calling close_binary the test expects get_evidence_bundle.records and .unknowns to both equal [].
Test explicitly named drains a file import before close_binary clears the session; postclose expects evidence records empty.

interpretation: Clearing Evidence and Unknowns when explicitly closing a BinarySession is the current REA source contract and is exercised by original source tests; the P225 incident was caused by applying a regular session close after unrelated global investigation records had been accumulated. Treat as a dangerous workflow/retention interaction, not an unproven random bug.
possible_remedies: Operational, no source change: BEFORE any close_binary, create and verify an immutable full Evidence bundle backup for that exact current investigation. After closure, import only via a new exact-path signed Ed25519 authorization, and independently verify all evidence IDs and Unknown revisions. IMPORTANT export and import are sensitive and cannot be automated from stale blanket approval.

Operational guard: prevent executing close_binary/open_binary in the original permanent REA MCP whenever an active Evidence/Unknown ledger could be lost, until an owner-approved backup and restoration process has passed isolated tests.

Product-level change, not deployed: redesign record lifetime versus BinarySession provider lifetime in an explicitly authorized source branch with updated regression tests and a safe migration plan. Do not silently change original REA semantics or assume existing tests will permit it.

Potential original API path: close_binary with snapshot_path saves an analysis snapshot before close; its exact schema/path, snapshot applicability to no-active-session state, recovery capabilities and owner authorization need separate validation and are NOT certified by this review.
safety_rules: Do not call open_binary or close_binary in original persistent MCP while 6 recovered Evidence are live unless preservation is independently established.
Do not restart service or change deployed source to simulate a fix.
Do not treat restoration of old six records as recovery of later P217/P218 Evidence or Unknowns.
Do not change the original GitHub Action workflow, security policy, Ed25519 verifier, provider routes, other projects, or historical certification count.
verification_scope: Read-only inspection of source and existing unit test expectations; no new MCP invocation, no functional remediation test, no evidence mutation.
next_safe_action: Design and test a retention-preserving certification workflow on isolated source-owned fixture, with exact owner-signed exports/imports and explicit no-loss checks, before production activation.
